test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An athlete crosses a 3000-m distance in 10 minutes. What is his speed (in km/h)?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 3000 m = 3 km, Time = 10 minutes = 10/60 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Speed = 3 km / (10/60) hours

⇒ Speed = 3 km / (1/6) hours

⇒ Speed = 3 × 6 km/h

⇒ Speed = 18 km/h

**The speed of the athlete is 18 km/h.**
